usage: The word 傢俬 (gaa1 si1) refers to furniture used in a home or office.
It is a noun and can be used to talk about both individual pieces of furniture and furniture sets.
You can say 傢俬砌唔齊 (gaa1 si1 cai3 m4 cai4) to express furniture pieces not fitting well together.
This word is often used with verbs like 買 (maai5, buy), 搬 (bun1, move), or 擺 (baai2, place).
You can describe furniture quality, color, or style by adding adjectives before 傢俬.

examples.meaning: I just bought some new furniture.
